Wow - that's a beauty! Love the contrast! This plant could make cool hybrids with a slash throat flava.


About the fancy names, we've always had the understanding that coloration alone was not a valid taxonomic distinction.
I'm not using varietal names anymore, either. I've seen plants that fall in between the so-called varieties and some that don't fit into any at all.  For example, I was able to legally collect a seedling of S. alata that has a dusky brown coloration to it.  That doesn't fit any of the varietal names at all.
